note: Card Y02: the automated scenario set. Each scenario names the compiled test files of a package ("pkg/path" is packages/pkg/dist/path.test.js) that prove one acceptance clause on the production code. `platforms` says where the scenario must pass; `platformFiles` adds files that only make sense on one platform. `minTests` is a floor: a file that was emptied or stopped registering its tests cannot keep a scenario green. Changing this file changes its digest, and a report made from another version is refused by the gate.
